summary: Iteration 154: Backup Center Advanced Acronis Features fully tested. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: Modern hero with 6 glow metric tiles, 6 tabs (Dashboard, Live, Acronis Console, Orphans, Compliance, Verify), Orphan scan returns real Acronis data (89 unprotected, 80 zombie plans), Agent Health shows 154/397 online, 200 active alerts with severity badges and dismiss buttons.

minor.issue: Returns empty stats object when Acronis API fails (graceful degradation, not a bug)

issues: Time column shows 'Invalid Date' for some backup jobs - likely missing/malformed timestamp in seed data

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Frontend was calling /api/backups (portal-only endpoint) instead of /api/backup-dashboard/overview
All 5 new Acronis endpoints working: orphans, agents/health, alerts dismiss, console-link, live-activities
Orphan scan correctly identifies: unprotected resources, stale backups, zombie plans, offline agents
Agent health correctly categorizes: online, offline_recent (<24h), stale (>24h)
Console-link correctly builds deep-link URLs with resource_id or alert_id params
All data-testid attributes present: tab-dashboard, tab-live, tab-acronis, tab-orphans, tab-compliance, tab-verify, run-orphan-scan-btn, open-acronis-console
seed_data_creation: None - uses live Acronis API data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backup Center at /backup-center has 6 tabs. Dashboard shows backup jobs table. Live tab shows running backups (empty when none running). Acronis Console tab has Quick Actions (4 buttons), Agent Health (Online/Offline/Stale tiles), Active Alerts list with dismiss buttons. Orphans tab has Run Scan button that queries live Acronis API - returns ~89 unprotected, ~80 zombie plans. Compliance and Verify tabs show existing data. Navigation has 'Backup Command Center' (new) and 'Acronis Tenants & Billing' (legacy /backup-dashboard).
